description: Reconcile gnomAD-predicted ABAT disease burden with reported case counts; quantify CSF biomarker fold changes and residual enzyme activity
code:
import requests, json
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research/1.0","Content-Type":"application/json"})
q="""query { gene(gene_symbol:"ABAT", reference_genome:GRCh38){
 variants(dataset: gnomad_r4){ hgvsp lof exome{ac an} genome{ac an} } } }"""
vs=S.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",data=json.dumps({"query":q}),timeout=300).json()["data"]["gene"]["variants"]
rows=[]
for v in vs:
    e=v.get("exome") or {}; g=v.get("genome") or {}
    ac=(e.get("ac") or 0)+(g.get("ac") or 0); an=(e.get("an") or 0)+(g.get("an") or 0)
    rows.append(dict(hgvsp=v.get("hgvsp") or "", lof=v.get("lof"), af=(ac/an if an else 0.0)))
G=pd.DataFrame(rows)
q_lof=G.loc[G.lof=="HC","af"].sum()
plp_mis=["p.Pro152Ser","p.Leu211Phe","p.Leu478Pro","p.Arg220Lys","p.Gln296His","p.Arg377Trp",
         "p.Arg92Gln","p.Phe213Cys","p.Gly465Asp","p.Gly465Arg"]
q_mis=G.loc[G.hgvsp.isin(plp_mis),"af"].sum()
q_tot=q_lof+q_mis
BIRTHS=132e6

# ---- Panel A: predicted vs observed ---------------------------------------
Fvals=np.linspace(0,0.04,200)
pred=(q_tot**2*(1-Fvals)+q_tot*Fvals)*BIRTHS
# observed: 20 distinct patients in the primary case literature over 1984-2026 (42 y)
obs_rate=20/42.0

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,4.6))
a=ax[0]
a.plot(Fvals,pred,color="#2b6cb0",lw=2.5,label="predicted affected births / year")
a.axhline(obs_rate,color="#c53030",ls="--",lw=2,label=f"reported cases / year = {obs_rate:.2f}")
a.set_yscale("log"); a.set_xlabel("population inbreeding coefficient F")
a.set_ylabel("affected births per year (world)")
a.set_title("Predicted genetic burden vs reported cases")
a.legend(fontsize=8); a.grid(alpha=.3)
for F,lab in [(0.0,"outbred"),(0.01,"global mean"),(0.03,"high consanguinity")]:
    y=(q_tot**2*(1-F)+q_tot*F)*BIRTHS
    a.plot([F],[y],"o",color="#2b6cb0"); a.annotate(lab,(F,y),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(4,6),fontsize=7)

# ---- Panel B: biomarker fold changes in the index case (PMID 6148708) ------
b=ax[1]
bm=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(metab="CSF free GABA\n(CHEBI:16865)", pat=4.8, ctrl_med=0.08),
 dict(metab="CSF homocarnosine\n(CHEBI:27859)", pat=23.4, ctrl_med=7.6),
 dict(metab="CSF beta-alanine\n(CHEBI:16958)", pat=0.48, ctrl_med=0.05),
])
bm["fc"]=bm.pat/bm.ctrl_med
bars=b.barh(bm.metab,bm.fc,color=["#c53030","#dd6b20","#d69e2e"])
for r,v in zip(bars,bm.fc): b.text(v*1.05,r.get_y()+r.get_height()/2,f"{v:.0f}x",va="center",fontsize=9)
b.set_xscale("log"); b.set_xlim(1,200); b.axvline(1,color="k",lw=1)
b.set_xlabel("fold change vs control median (log scale)")
b.set_title("CSF biomarkers, index case (PMID 6148708)")
b.grid(alpha=.3,axis="x")

# ---- Panel C: residual GABA-T activity -------------------------------------
c=ax[2]
act=pd.DataFrame([dict(g="patient liver",v=0.07),dict(g="control min",v=0.31),
                  dict(g="control median",v=0.38),dict(g="control max",v=0.69)])
c.bar(act.g,act.v,color=["#c53030","#a0aec0","#718096","#a0aec0"])
c.axhline(0.31,ls=":",color="k",lw=1)
c.set_ylabel("GABA-T activity (umol/mg protein/h)")
c.set_title("Residual hepatic GABA-T, index case")
c.tick_params(axis="x",rotation=20); c.grid(alpha=.3,axis="y")
pct=0.07/0.38*100
c.text(0,0.09,f"{pct:.0f}% of\ncontrol median",ha="center",fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print(f"q_total={q_tot:.3e}; carrier 1 in {1/(2*q_tot):,.0f}")
print("Predicted affected births/yr: F=0 -> %.1f ; F=0.01 -> %.0f ; F=0.03 -> %.0f"%(
      q_tot**2*BIRTHS,(q_tot**2*0.99+q_tot*0.01)*BIRTHS,(q_tot**2*0.97+q_tot*0.03)*BIRTHS))
print("Observed reported cases/yr (1984-2026):",round(obs_rate,2))
print("Ratio predicted/observed at F=0 : %.1f"%(q_tot**2*BIRTHS/obs_rate))
print("Residual activity index case: %.1f%% of control median, %.1f%% of control minimum"%(pct,0.07/0.31*100))
print("Biomarker fold changes:"); print(bm[["metab","fc"]].to_string(index=False))
